title: Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection via Group Sparse Low-Rank Tensor Factorization With Automatic Anomaly Grouping
summary: Low-rank tensor modeling has become an effective tool for hyperspectral anomaly detection. However, existing methods still suffer from high computational cost and limited flexibility in characterizing spatially structured anomalies. To address these issues, this paper proposes a hyperspectral anomaly detection method based on group sparse low-rank tensor factorization with automatic anomaly grouping (GSAA). Specifically, the low tubal rank background is characterized by imposing group sparsity on tensor factors, which provides an efficient alternative to direct tensor rank regularization.…
